about: Budgets for `npm run bench:check` (see tools/bench-check.ts), under Node, the engine games ship with. Each is about 2.5 to 3 times what the scene took on a 4-core 2.1 GHz cloud VM on 2026-11-10, with a floor of 3 ms so a scene that takes a fraction of a millisecond does not fail on runner noise. A slower or noisier CI runner passes and a real regression (twice the work, or an algorithm that turns quadratic) fails. `ratios` do not depend on how fast the machine is: a scene with 4 times the objects should take about 4 times as long, and 16 times means quadratic. When a change makes a scene faster for good, lower its budget in the same PR; when one makes it slower on purpose, raise it and say why. There are no budgets for the QuickJS host; `node packages/player/bench/frame.ts` bundled with `npm run bundle` can still be run under it by hand.
